response.sql: SELECT races.name, AVG(constructorStandings.wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings JOIN races ON races.raceId = constructorStandings.raceId WHERE constructorStandings.points > 6.0 GROUP BY races.name ORDER BY races.name

assumptions.assumption: "clear the 6.0-point threshold" means points > 6.0 (strictly greater than), not >= 6.0. This is the primary reading of "clear" as exceeding rather than meeting.

alternatives.interpretation: "clear the 6.0-point threshold" could mean points >= 6.0 (meet or exceed the threshold).
